## Function 1 - pluralize_gift
```{python}
#| label: Function 1 - pluralize_gift

def pluralize_gift(gift):
  """
  Returns plural of a noun
  
  Parameters
  ----------
  gift: str
    A noun
    
  Return
  ------
  str
    Plural version
  """

  if "oo" in gift:
    gift_plural = gift.replace("oo", "ee")
  elif re.search(r"y$", gift):
    gift_plural = gift.replace("y", "ies")
  else:
    gift_plural = gift + "s"

  return gift_plural

```

```{python}
test = list(test)
print(" ".join(test))

```

## Function 2 - make_phrase
```{python}
#| label: Function 2 - make_phrase

def make_phrase(df, num, num_word, item, verb, adjective, location):
  """
  Returns strings of song lyrics
  
  Parameters
  ----------
  df: dataframe
    dataframe containing the columns: Day, Day.in.Words, Gift.Item, Verb, Adjective, Location
  num: int
    number
  num_word: str
    day in words
  item: str
    gift
  verb: str
    verb describing gift
  adjective: str
    adjective describing gift
  location: str
   location of gift

  Return
  ------
  str
    song lyric phrases adjusted for grammar of input
  """
  
  ## Step 1: Replace NAs with blank strings
  verb = "" if pd.isna(verb) else verb
  adjective = "" if pd.isna(adjective) else adjective
  location = "" if pd.isna(location) else location

  ## Step 2: If the day number is larger than 1, the gift items need pluralized!
  ### Hint: call the function you created above!
  if num == 1:
    item = item
  else: 
    item = pluralize_gift(item)
  
  ## Step 3: Figure out if a gift item starts with a vowel
  vowels = ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u"]
  starts_with = r"^[" + "".join(vowels) + "]"

  ## Step 4: For the first day, if the gift item starts with a vowel, replace the day with "an" and if the gift item does not start with a vowel, replace the day with "a" (e.g. a partridge in a pear tree). If it is not the first day, use just the number word (e.g. ten lords a leap)
  if ((num == 1) and (re.search(starts_with, item))):
    digit = "an"
  elif (num == 1):
    digit = "a"
  else:
    digit_dictionary = {
        2: "two", 3: "three", 4: "four", 5: "five", 6: "six", 7: "seven", 8: "eight", 9: "nine", 10: "ten", 11: "eleven", 12: "twelve"
    } 
    digit = digit_dictionary.get(num, str(num))
  
  ## Step 5: Put all of the pieces together into one string and return!
  phrase = digit + " " + adjective + " " + item + " " + verb + " " + location
  phrase = phrase.replace("  ", " ").strip()
  # alternative method: phrase = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", phrase).strip()

  return phrase

```

## Function 3 - sing_day
```{python}
#| label: Function 3 - sing day

def sing_day(df, num, phrase_col):
  """
  Returns strings of song lyrics for each day
  
  Parameters
  ----------
  df: dataframe
    dataframe containing the columns: Day, Day.in.Words, Gift.Item, Verb, Adjective, Location
  num: int
    number of day
  phrase_col: str
    name of the column in dataframe in which to find the day's phrase

  Return
  ------
  str
    verse song lyrics
  """

  # Step 1: Setup the intro line
  num_word = df.loc[df["Day"] == num, "Day.in.Words"].values[0]  # convert "1" to "first" etc.
  intro = "On the " + num_word + " day of Christmas, my true love sent to me:\n"
  
  # Step 2: Sing the gift phrases
  # Hint: What order are the gifts sung in each day?
  gifts = ""
  for i in range(num, 0, -1):
    gifts = gifts + df.loc[df["Day"] == i, phrase_col].values[0]
    if i == 2:
      gifts = gifts + ", and\n"
    elif i == 1:
      gifts = gifts + ".\n\n"
    else: 
      gifts = gifts + ",\n"

  # Step 3: Put it all together and return
  day = intro + gifts

  return day

```

Testing
```{python}
#| label: Testing Function 3
#| code-fold: true

# test with provided day
day = sing_day(xmas, 3, "Full.Phrase")
print("".join(day))

```

## Use Your Functions!
```{python}
#| label: Complete song

# Printing out the complete song based on xmas df
song = map(lambda i: sing_day(xmas, i, "Full.Phrase"), range(1, len(xmas)+1, 1))
song = list(song)
print("".join(song))

```

# Secret Song
```{python}
#| label: Use Your Functions! -- Secret Song

# load new dataset
xmas2 = pd.read_csv("https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/p9x9k8xwuzs9rhp582vfy/xmas_2.csv?rlkey=kvc3j3lmyn4opcidsrhcmrof1&dl=1")

# adding column of phrases to new dataset
xmas2["Full.Phrase"] = xmas2.apply(lambda x: make_phrase(xmas2, x['Day'], x['Day.in.Words'], x['Gift.Item'], x['Verb'], x['Adjective'], x['Location']), axis = 1)

# putting together phrases for full song
song_2 = map(lambda i: sing_day(xmas2, i, "Full.Phrase"), range(1, len(xmas2) +1, 1))
song_2 = list(song_2)
print("".join(song_2))

```
